entries.source_and_evidence: Godot 4.7 official TextureRect and importing-images documentation checked on 2026-09-02: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.7/classes/class_texturerect.html and https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/assets_pipeline/importing_images.html.
entries.observed_pattern: TextureRect supports aspect-covered clipping for an oversized stage crop, while PNG is a supported 2D texture format and lossless import is the normal 2D choice when transparency and edge quality matter.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADAPT the existing TextureRect with EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE and STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED; keep the new image as a lossless RGBA PNG with explicit crop/anchor metadata rather than adding an addon, shader framework, or a new paid image path.
